name: Peligent AI Assistant
author: peligent

sections.description:
Peligent AI Assistant – A Smarter Way to Manage Your WordPress Website

Peligent AI Assistant is an AI powered assistant built for WordPress and WooCommerce website owners who want to manage their website in less time.

We built Peligent because running a website takes too many hours. Uploading products, editing images, writing descriptions, and checking orders should be easier.
This plugin brings AI into your website admin to support you with the power of AI.

What You Can Do With Peligent AI Assistant
Product Image Background Removal
Upload a regular product image, Peligent AI assistant takes care of the rest, it removes the background automatically using AI, and creates a clean, professional-looking product image with a studio-style background that fits your business and industry.

Write Product Descriptions Faster

Generate clear, professional product descriptions using AI.

Instead of staring at a blank, you can create product content in seconds and adjust it to match your tone and store style.

Ask Questions About Your Store
Use the AI chat assistant directly inside your WordPress admin area.

You can ask questions about your store, including:
* Current orders
* Order status
* Store related information

The assistant is available in a sidebar, so you never need to leave your dashboard.

Works in Multiple Languages

Peligent AI Assistant supports multiple languages, making it useful for website owners and teams around the world.

If you can use WordPress, you can use Peligent.

This Is Just the Beginning

We are actively working on new features that will help you manage your website faster, automate more tasks, and reduce the time spent on daily admin work.

Built With Your Feedback

Peligent is built for the WordPress community.

If you have ideas on how AI can help you manage your website or online store, email us at support@peligent.com.
We take feedback seriously, and we are committed to ongoing improvements and regular updates.

Install Peligent AI Assistant and spend less time managing your website and more time growing it.

How it works

After activation, visit WooCommerce → Peligent. Paste your Peligent Connect Secret, click “Save & Connect to Peligent”. The plugin saves the secret, generates/uses the stored credentials, and sends them to Peligent.

External services

This plugin connects to the Peligent API service (https://app.peligent.com) to send WooCommerce REST API credentials and establish the connection between your WooCommerce store and your Peligent account.

What data is sent and when:
– WooCommerce REST API key credentials (consumer key and consumer secret)
– Application user credentials (username and application password)
– Store URL and connection token

This data is sent only when you click “Save & Connect to Peligent” button in the plugin settings page, or when the connection is automatically established during activation if a connect token is already configured.

The connection is made over HTTPS with your Peligent Connect Secret included in the request headers for authentication.

Service provider: Peligent
– Terms of Service: https://peligent.com/terms
– Privacy Policy: https://peligent.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory or install via the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce → Peligent.
  4. Paste your Peligent Connect Secret.
  5. Click “Save & Connect to Peligent” and follow the redirect to your Peligent dashboard.
sections.faq:
Where do I find the Peligent Connect Secret?

In your Peligent dashboard under Websites → Connect Secret.

What capabilities does the generated user have?

The plugin ensures the generated user has Administrator role in order to manage WooCommerce resources and users where required by automation. You can revoke it from the settings page at any time.

Is data sent securely?

Yes. The plugin posts over HTTPS to https://app.peligent.com with your Connect Secret in the X-Peligent-Connect-Token header.
